ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I picked Dunlin because the query is a clear-cut computation (it's $(101-1)^4 = 100^4 = 10^8$), and on this kind of well-defined quantitative task the deciding factor is raw capability. Dunlin leads Avocet on every relevant benchmark—MMLU-Pro (80.9 vs 75.9), GPQA Diamond (64.8 vs 56.2), and Arena-Hard (90.2 vs 83.2)—while cost and latency are identical. No task-preference dimension for either model is triggered by a neutral math problem, so the higher-capability model wins by default.
